page.overview:
Who is Alkimedon?

Alkimedon was an Arkadian hero, he was the father of Phialo.

Herakles seduced Alkimedon' daughter. When Alkimedon learned of Phialo's liaison with Herakles and her consequential pregnancy, Aekhmagoras left his daughter and her son bound and gagged on Mount Ostrakina. Herakles' son let out a great cry which was heard by a jay bird. The Jay found Herakles and mimicked the cries of his son. Herakles returned to Arkadia and freed Phialo and Aekhmagoras.
